og.suspendHint: Suspending stops its admins and teachers from using their staff screens until you resume it. Its members keep learning, and its courses and web address keep working.
og.suspendBody: Its admins and teachers lose their staff access at once. Its members keep learning.
og.suspendedOk: Suspended. Its admins and teachers have lost their staff access.
og.staffFailed: Staff accounts that could not be updated just now: {n}. They follow by themselves within six hours.
og.resumeHint: Its admins and teachers can't use their staff screens until you resume it. Its members keep learning.
og.resumed: Resumed. Its admins and teachers have their staff access back.
og.delReleaseHint: Everyone keeps their account and their learning, and becomes an independent learner.
og.delManaged: Delete the accounts the organization made
og.delManagedHint: The username logins the organization made are deleted with their data. Everyone else is released and keeps their account and learning.
og.delRunning: Deleting. Keep this page open until it finishes.
og.delStopped: The deletion stopped before the end. Nothing is lost: press Continue to go on from where it stopped.
og.deletingBody: This organization is being deleted, and nothing in it can be changed. Type its name and press Continue to finish the deletion.
og.deletedManaged: {name} was deleted. The accounts it made are being deleted, and its other members are now independent learners.
og.roleBody: They are signed out and sign in again with the new role. A student who becomes a teacher or an admin loses their own teacher; a teacher who becomes a student leaves their students without one.
og.exportHint: Downloads every member's profile, lesson results, projects and certificates as compressed JSON files (.json.gz). Private notes and payments are never included.
og.exportProgress: Preparing the files. Members exported so far: {n}
og.exportEmpty: This organization has no members, so there is nothing to download.
og.exportFileFailed: A file could not be downloaded.
og.xlsxFailed: The Excel file could not be made.
og.accSuspendBody: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until the account is restored.
